tools.name: ai_chat
tools.description: Chat with a specific AI provider. Sends a prompt and returns the response. Optionally saves the response as a workspace document.

files.description: File paths to include as context

allow_external_paths.description: Opt-in: allow absolute file paths outside the workspace base directory. Default false. Relative paths remain sandboxed either way. Audit trail is the call log — use sparingly.

timeout_ms.description: Per-call provider chat timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to AI_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS (300000 = 5 minutes); raise up to 3600000 (60 minutes) for large reviews. The same value is forwarded to the provider chat request and (for ai_chat) to the auto-fallback race.

kind.description: Semantic placement: 'individual' (per-provider initial analysis) → individual/, 'debate' (round-by-round working docs) → debates/, 'synthesis' (final consensus) → synthesis/, 'general' (default, legacy) → reviews/.

save_as_document.description: If provided, automatically save the response as a workspace document with the given title and metadata. Returns document ID in the result.

tools.name: ai_analyze_files
tools.description: Analyze files with an AI provider. Reads files from disk, sends contents with a question, and optionally saves the result.

question.description: Question to ask about the files

save_to_file.description: Path to save the analysis result

allow_external_paths.description: Opt-in: allow absolute file paths outside the workspace base directory. Default false.

timeout_ms.description: Per-call provider chat timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to AI_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS (300000 = 5 minutes); raise up to 3600000 (60 minutes) for large reviews. The same value is forwarded to the provider chat request and (for ai_chat) to the auto-fallback race.

tools.name: ai_compare
tools.description: Send the same prompt to multiple providers and return a comparison. Optionally aggregate results into a unified synthesis using a designated provider.

providers.description: List of provider IDs to compare

prompt.description: Prompt to send to all providers

aggregate_provider.description: Provider ID to synthesize all responses into a unified document. If omitted, returns raw comparisons only.

aggregate_prompt.description: Custom synthesis prompt. Default: synthesize and identify agreements/disagreements.

timeout_ms.description: Per-call provider chat timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to AI_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS (300000 = 5 minutes); raise up to 3600000 (60 minutes) for large reviews. The same value is forwarded to the provider chat request and (for ai_chat) to the auto-fallback race.

tools.name: agent_debate_start
tools.description: Start a multi-provider debate on a topic. Optionally enable enhanced mode with goal-based quality validation.

goal.description: Quality goal for enhanced debate mode (enables quality validation loop)

validator.description: Provider ID for quality validation (agent-tier recommended)

tools.name: agent_debate_status
tools.description: Check the status and result of a debate session.

tools.name: agent_cross_validate
tools.description: Cross-validate work outputs. Each item is reviewed by agent-tier providers. Tool-tier providers cannot be validators.

validators.description: Provider IDs to use as validators (agent-tier only)

tools.name: agent_debate_create
tools.description: Create a turn-based debate session. Returns a debate ID for use with agent_debate_turn and agent_debate_conclude.

save_document.description: Save debate as a workspace document (default: true)

tools.name: agent_debate_turn
tools.description: Execute one provider's turn in a debate. Optionally inject Claude's comment before the provider responds. Returns the provider's response. Use provider: "claude" with claude_comment to record Claude's own independent opinion as a debate turn.

provider.description: Provider ID to take this turn. Use "claude" to record Claude's own opinion as an independent turn (requires claude_comment).

claude_comment.description: Claude's opinion. When provider is "claude", this becomes the turn content. Otherwise, injected before the provider responds.

auto_specialist.description: When true with provider 'claude', automatically select and record a specialist agent recommendation based on the debate topic.

tools.name: agent_debate_conclude
tools.description: End a debate session and generate the final transcript. Optionally add Claude's summary and quality scores for each provider.

summary.description: Claude's final summary of the debate

quality_scores.description: Quality assessment of each provider's contribution

tools.name: agent_debate_review
tools.description: Send a document to multiple providers for structured review. Each provider responds with agree/disagree and feedback. Use iteratively: review → revise document based on feedback → review again until all agree.

providers.description: Provider IDs to review the document

review_prompt.description: Custom review instructions (default: agree/disagree with feedback)

debate_id.description: Link reviews to an existing debate session's workspace document

tools.name: agent_changes_review
tools.description: Review file changes made by an external AI in an isolated worktree. Shows diff stat and full diff.

task_id.description: Task ID to review changes for

tools.name: agent_changes_accept
tools.description: Accept and merge file changes from an isolated worktree back to the main branch.

task_id.description: Task ID whose changes to accept

tools.name: agent_changes_reject
tools.description: Reject file changes and clean up the isolated worktree.

task_id.description: Task ID whose changes to reject

tools.name: agent_consensus_start
tools.description: Start the consensus round engine from an explicit participant list and initial_aggregation JSON. The engine does not inject specialists, run research, or create individual-review fan-out. By default it starts in the background and returns a tracking receipt; call agent_debate_status to recover state and artifacts. No synthesis is written until the leader approves or rejects a ready-for-approval/escalated session.

topic.description: Short name for the consensus session.

scope.description: Consensus scope. The engine stores and forwards it but does not interpret it.

taskLabel.description: Human-readable label only. The engine never branches on it.

sourceWorkflow.description: Human-readable origin label for the caller/preprocessor.

metadata.description: Optional labels for humans and artifacts. These values never affect engine behavior.

workspace_base_dir.description: Optional absolute target workspace root. Use when the host workspace root is unavailable, the target project differs from the MCP server runtime directory, or the target is a new folder without project markers.

leader.description: Participant ID authorized to approve the final synthesis. Defaults to the session-context leader or the first participant.

participants.description: Exact participant IDs for consensus rounds. The engine never injects participants.

agent_name.description: Host-native agent name to show in pending_host_turns, e.g. agestra-debate.

participant_routes.description: Explicit host-native participant routes. Only these routes create pending host turns.

id.description: Optional source-local id. The engine still allocates stable ITEM-* ids.

proposer.description: Participant, provider, host artifact, or preprocessor that proposed this item.

status.description: Initial ledger status. Missing means unresolved.

preAgreedBy.description: Participants whose agreement was already established by preprocessing.

initial_aggregation.description: Leader/research/debate preprocessed JSON items that seed the consensus ledger.

max_rounds.description: Maximum number of rounds. Default: STRUCTURED_DEBATE_DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS.

participant_timeout_ms.description: Optional per-participant inactivity timeout in milliseconds for consensus provider turns. Default is 300000 (5 minutes); use 600000 (10 minutes) for large or deep reviews.

background.description: When true (default), start in the background and return a tracking receipt. When false, wait for the final engine result in this tool call.

await_completion_ms.description: When background is true, wait up to this many milliseconds for a quick completion before returning the tracking receipt.

files.description: Optional list of files to pass to participants as context.

locale.description: Override config locale for system text in this consensus session only.

tools.name: agent_research_consensus_start
tools.description: Start the dedicated host-led research consensus flow. This entry point does not accept source_documents; research submissions are collected and preprocessed before consensus starts.

domain.description: Target domain for host-led research consensus. Direct consensus starts from host-prepared initial_aggregation items.

objective.description: What the research consensus flow should investigate and resolve.

workspace_base_dir.description: Optional absolute target workspace root. Use when the host workspace root is unavailable, the target project differs from the MCP server runtime directory, or the target is a new folder without project markers.

participants.description: Provider or host participant IDs for the later debate phase. Research bundle pseudo-participants are rejected.

research_assignments.description: Optional host-owned research assignments for providers or host researchers.

provider_order.description: Optional debate provider order. Defaults to participants order when omitted.

max_rounds.description: Maximum structured consensus rounds once debate wiring is enabled.

background.description: When true, consensus may continue in the background after research preprocessing.

write_aggregation_document.description: Write the human-readable aggregation document under docs/agestra. It summarizes participant comments and evidence; raw JSON remains in internal artifacts.

write_result_document.description: Return the docs/agestra target path for the team-lead-authored final decision document. The engine does not write this document.

tools.name: agent_debate_approve
tools.description: Leader-approve a ready-for-approval structured-debate session. Writes the synthesis document and marks the session approved.

session_id.description: Consensus session ID returned from agent_consensus_start

leader_note.description: Optional note appended to the synthesis footer under 'Leader approval notes'.

tools.name: agent_debate_continue
tools.description: Run additional rounds on a ready-for-approval (or escalated) structured-debate session. Choose 3, 5, or 10 extra rounds. Defaults to background execution; set background=false or await_completion_ms when the caller should wait for a bounded result.

session_id.description: Consensus session ID returned from agent_consensus_start

additional_rounds.description: How many extra rounds to run beyond the current round count. Choose one of 3, 5, or 10.

background.description: When true (default), continue in the background and return a tracking receipt. When false, wait for the additional rounds to finish in this tool call.

await_completion_ms.description: When background is true, wait up to this many milliseconds for quick completion before returning the tracking receipt.

tools.name: agent_debate_reject
tools.description: Reject a ready-for-approval (or escalated/leader-timeout) structured-debate session. Writes a rejected synthesis, marks the transcript rejected, and optionally writes an issue document.

session_id.description: Consensus session ID returned from agent_consensus_start

reason.description: Optional rejection reason, captured in the debate transcript footer.

spawn_issue.description: If true, also write an issue_{sessionIdShort}_{YYYYMMDD}_{seq}.md under individual/ listing all non-accepted proposals (rejected/withdrawn/open/inconclusive/superseded). A rejected synthesis is always written.

tools.name: agent_consensus_submit_turn
tools.description: Submit an explicit host-native participant turn. When `agent_debate_status` reports `phase: awaiting-host-turn`, the host dispatches each `pending_host_turns` entry through the route declared in participant_routes and posts JSON/text output back here. Every consensus-round host turn uses the consensus JSON contract. Once every pending host participant has answered, the workflow resumes automatically.

session_id.description: Consensus session ID returned from agent_consensus_start.

participant_id.description: Explicit host-native participant id the host fulfilled. Must match an entry under `pending_host_turns` in `agent_debate_status`.

content.description: Verbatim content produced by the host route. Consensus-round handoffs must return the same JSON consensus contract used for provider turns.

round.description: Round number from the matching pending host-turn entry. When supplied the engine rejects mismatched submissions to catch stale responses.

tools.name: agent_research_record
tools.description: Record host-owned research evidence for a provider-backed research workflow. Writes run_report.json, gate_ledger.json, evidence_packet.json, artifact_index.json, and an optional Markdown report.

session_id.description: Optional stable research run/session id. If omitted, the server generates one.

research_target_domain.description: The domain the research is about. The MCP workflow itself is standalone research.

topology.description: Research topology to record. Legacy topology ids are accepted only as parse aliases and runtime values are canonical.

status.description: Research run status to record in the run manifest and report.

markdown_report_path.description: Optional human Markdown report path under docs/reports/research or .agestra/workspace. Must be a new .md file.

markdown_report_body.description: Optional Markdown report body to write. The server appends an execution-evidence section when missing.

research_plan.description: Optional host-evidence research plan or brief to persist as research_plan.json.

assignment_table.description: Optional assignment table. Host-seeded runs may omit or pass an empty table.

claims.description: Claim/evidence entries to write into evidence_packet.json.

available_provider_ids.description: Providers observed as available by the host. If omitted, the server records registered provider ids when available.

non_invocation_reason.description: How this host evidence will feed provider-backed review or debate.

validation_notes.description: Short validation notes or residual risks for the run report.

tools.name: workspace_create_review
tools.description: Create a code review document for the specified files with given review rules.

files.description: File paths to include in the review

workspace_base_dir.description: Optional absolute target workspace root. Use when the current host root is unavailable or the target project differs from the MCP server runtime directory.

tools.name: workspace_request_review
tools.description: Request AI provider(s) to perform a code review on an existing review document. Returns immediately with a session ID. Use workspace_review_status to check progress.

doc_id.description: Document ID to request review for

provider.description: Provider ID(s) to perform the review

workspace_base_dir.description: Optional absolute target workspace root for resolving the review document store.

tools.name: workspace_review_status
tools.description: Check the status of an async review session started by workspace_request_review.

workspace_base_dir.description: Optional absolute target workspace root for resolving the review session store.

tools.name: workspace_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing review document.

workspace_base_dir.description: Optional absolute target workspace root for resolving the document store.

tools.name: workspace_create_document
tools.description: Create a general-purpose workspace document with a title, content, and optional metadata. Use for independent analysis documents, aggregated reports, or any structured output.

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata (e.g. Provider, Task, Mode)

kind.description: Semantic placement: 'individual' (per-provider independent work) → individual/, 'debate' (round-by-round working docs) → debates/, 'synthesis' (final consensus) → synthesis/, 'general' (default, legacy) → reviews/. Always pass an explicit kind for idea/review workflows so the workspace tree stays sorted.

workspace_base_dir.description: Optional absolute target workspace root. Use this to force documents into a specific project, including a new folder that has no .git/package markers yet.

tools.name: workspace_read
tools.description: Read the contents of a workspace document.

workspace_base_dir.description: Optional absolute target workspace root for resolving the document store.

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List all workspace documents.

workspace_base_dir.description: Optional absolute target workspace root for resolving the document store.

tools.name: provider_list
tools.description: List all registered AI providers with their availability status and capabilities.

tools.name: provider_health
tools.description: Run health checks on AI providers. Optionally specify a provider ID, or omit to check all.

provider.description: Provider ID to check (omit to check all)

tools.name: provider_readiness
tools.description: Check configured providers for path/version/auth/workspace trust readiness before model invocation.

providers.description: Provider IDs to check (omit to check configured/registered providers)

workspace_base_dir.description: Absolute target workspace root for workspace trust checks

tools.name: provider_trust_apply
tools.description: After explicit user approval, add the exact workspace root to a provider's trusted-folder store when supported.

provider.description: Provider ID whose workspace trust should be updated

workspace_base_dir.description: Exact target workspace root to trust

approved.description: Must be true after explicit user approval

tools.name: provider_trust_apply_all
tools.description: After one explicit user approval, add the exact workspace root to every supported provider's trusted-folder store.

providers.description: Provider IDs whose workspace trust should be updated

workspace_base_dir.description: Exact target workspace root to trust

approved.description: Must be true after explicit user approval

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description: Detect available AI providers and show the current Agestra setup state from providers.config.json.

tools.name: setup_apply
tools.description: Write the selected AI providers and locale into providers.config.json for Agestra workflows.

tools.name: host_assets_status
tools.description: Check whether Codex host-native Agestra custom agents and skills are installed and current. The host_assets_* MCP tools currently manage Codex assets only.

tools.name: host_assets_install
tools.description: Explicitly install or refresh Codex host-native Agestra assets by writing managed custom agent TOML files and skills.

tools.name: host_assets_uninstall
tools.description: Remove managed Codex host-native Agestra assets tracked in the Agestra host asset manifest.

tools.name: cli_job_submit
tools.description: Submit a long-running CLI job to a provider. Returns a job ID immediately. Use cli_job_status to check progress.

prompt.description: Prompt to send to the provider CLI

save_as_document.description: If set, the job output will be saved as a workspace document on completion. Returned via cli_job_status once finalized.

tools.name: cli_job_status
tools.description: Check the status of a CLI job. Returns state, output (on completion), and stderr.

tools.name: trace_query
tools.description: Query trace records with filtering. Returns recent provider interactions with latency, quality scores, and reasoning.

tools.name: trace_summary
tools.description: Get quality and performance stats per provider and task type. Shows average quality scores, latency, and success rates.

tools.name: trace_visualize
tools.description: Generate a Mermaid diagram showing the flow of a traced operation. Shows provider selection, execution, and quality assessment.

tools.name: trace_prompt_read
tools.description: Read a prompt capsule by prompt_id. Hidden system/objective/rendered prompt text is returned only when AGESTRA_PROMPT_CAPSULE_MODE=debug-full and include_hidden_parts=true.

tools.name: environment_check
tools.description: Check installed AI CLI tools (codex, gemini), infrastructure (tmux, git worktree), and Ollama models. Returns a capability map showing available v3 orchestration modes. Results are cached per session — call with force_refresh to re-check.

force_refresh.description: Force re-check even if cached (default: false)

tools.name: cli_worker_spawn
tools.description: Spawn a CLI AI worker (any registered provider; use `provider_list` to discover available) in autonomous mode. The worker runs in the background and can be monitored with cli_worker_status.

tools.name: cli_worker_status
tools.description: Get the status of a CLI worker by ID, or list all tracked workers if no ID is given.

tools.name: cli_worker_collect
tools.description: Collect results from a successful COLLECTING worker, a completed worker, or a failed CLI worker. Returns full output, git diff, and changed files.

tools.name: cli_worker_stop
tools.description: Stop a running CLI worker. Sends SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 5 seconds.

tools.name: qa_run
tools.description: Run vetted build/test QA profiles for the target workspace. Optionally includes a design document reference and returns a PASS/FAIL summary with captured output.

design_doc.description: Optional design document path to verify against

build_profile.description: QA build profile to execute. Defaults to 'auto' which detects from project structure.

tools.name: run_observable_events
tools.description: Poll a generic observable event stream by run, session, worker, or job locator. Returns a cursor-safe bounded event tail.
